purpose: Step 8 Call 1 evaluation-only DefinitionRef gold for the fixed 26-case KCL substantive cohort.

label_policy.positive_scope: Closed catalog DefinitionRefs that the reviewed rubric requires the answer to examine, including ultimately rejected offense theories.
label_policy.negative_scope: Special-law, out-of-catalog, and completion-only issues receive a scope note and do not create an invented DefinitionRef label.
label_policy.seed_level: Definition type, never actor, victim, event, mode, or occurrence. A derived offense is labelled when the rubric's legal issue is that derived offense.
